title: Haaye Hassan Moula
body:
Zehra ka jigar paara, haider ka dulara..(2)
haye hasan maula, haye hasan maula
nikla hai tera ghar se do baar janaza
<<MINI>>
haye hasan maula
haye hasan maula..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Joda ne jigar tukde kar daala tumhara
haider ki adawat ka liya tumse hai badla
is zulm se karbal ka aaghaaz hua tha
<<MINI>>
haye hasan maula..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Shabbir pe aur tujhpe ek jaisa sitam tha
yaa teer janaze par, waha'n teero pe laasha
do baar hua tukde zehra ka kaleja
<<MINI>>
haye hasan maula..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Teero se bhara laasha ghar laut ke aaya
pehchaan nahi paayi zainab tera laasha
dil thaam ke zainab ne har teer nikala
<<MINI>>
haye hasan maula..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Tukde tha jigar tera jis tarha se maula
qasim ka badan tukde usi tarha hua tha
puche koi ummat se kya jurm tha tera
<<MINI>>
haye hasan maula..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Chauda so(1400) baras beete ye zakhm hai taaza
farhan ho ya mazhar sab karte hai nauha
taa hashr tere ghum mein royegi ye duniya
<<MINI>>
haye hasan maula..(3)
